newsitem.title: USA: Gelman to move forward with Memtec deal.
newsitem.headline: Gelman to move forward with Memtec deal.

text.p: Gelman Sciences Inc said on Thursday it intended to pursue its agreed acquisition by Memtec Ltd, but added that its agreement allows it to respond to enquiries and engage in discussions with Pall Corp and other interested parties.
Pall said Thursday it hah had talks with Gelman about a possible acquisition of the company.

"We intend to continue moving forward with Memtec, but the board of directors is committed to maximizing shareholder value and is responding as appropriate to the Pall inquiry," Gelman Chairman Charles Gelman said in a statement.
